description:
Fast Castle Build focusing on gold gathering from relics and sacred sites

- Build 1st landmark near resources with priority on food and stone (if planning 2nd TC for late game)
- TC is always going to food once you have gold villagers
name: Zhu Xi Legacy Fast Castle [Aussie Drongo]
author: Sazed

notes: 2 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.png@ build @landmark_zhuxi/meditation-gardens-1.png@ near resources (@resource/rally.png@ them to @resource/resource_gold.png@)
-- If enemy @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@, move some @resource/resource_food.png@@unit_worker/villager-china.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ to make @unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@
Focus on getting to Song with @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@@resource/resource_gold.png@ drop off
Build @landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.webp@ with 9-10 @resource/resource_food.png@@unit_worker/villager-china.png@ to get to Song Dynasty
-- Queue another @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ to gather gold automatically
Build @building_military/barracks.webp@,@building_military/archery-range.png@ or @building_military/stable.png@ to counter enemy army
Focus on gathering @resource/relics.webp@  and capture @resource/sacred_sites.png@ for more @resource/resource_gold.png@
-- Balance resources to go 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ with @resource/resource_stone.png@ from @landmark_zhuxi/meditation-gardens-1.png@
-- Continue building @building_military/barracks.webp@,@building_military/archery-range.png@ or @building_military/stable.png@ to counter enemy
Go for 3rd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ if you'd like or go to @age/age_4.png@
5x @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ chop closest tree unitl each @unit_worker/villager-china.png@ has 7 @resource/resource_wood.png@ each.

5x@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ build @building_economy/mill.png@ near berries, send starting sheep towards the mill you are making. @unit_chinese/imperial-official.png@ supervises mill while you are building it so you get bonus wood.

5x@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to sheep under the @building_economy/mill.png@ with @unit_chinese/imperial-official.png@ supervising. 1x @unit_worker/villager-china.png@ builds @building_chinese/village.png@ near berries.
7x @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ on sheep. Start to rally onto the @resource/resource_gold.png@.
Rally onto gold until you have 3x@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.png@.
Rally @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ onto @resource/resource_food.png@ until you have enough for @landmark_zhuxi/meditation-gardens-1.png@.
Collect tax with your @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ from the @building_economy/mill.png@ when it hits 40 then continue to supervise the @building_economy/mill.png@.

Continue rallying out to @resource/resource_food.webp@ until you have enough for @landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.png@. Pull your @resource/resource_gold.png@@unit_worker/villager-china.png@ off when you get exactly 170 @resource/resource_gold.png@.

Send the @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-china.png@ to stragler trees near main TC. Send 6x @unit_worker/villager-china.png@ from @resource/resource_food.png@ to construct a mining camp on the @resource/resource_stone.png@. Use the @unit_chinese/imperial-official.png@ to supervise the @resource/resource_stone.png@.

The 2x @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ that were making @landmark_zhuxi/meditation-gardens-1.png@ will then make the @landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.png@ once the @landmark_zhuxi/meditation-gardens-1.png@ is completed. Rally new @unit_worker/villager-china.png@ onto wood.
Once you get 350 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ pull 6x @unit_worker/villager-china.png@ off and go to @resource/resource_wood.png@ until you can afford 2nd @building_economy/town-center.png@.

Keep majority of @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.png@ as spamming production buildings grants you free units essentially driving the cost of the production building down to a fraction of the price. Wood also helps you afford an early @building_chinese/granary.png@ and @building_economy/farm.png@ which means you never need to leave your base.

name: Zhu Xi's Legacy Fast Aggression [ Beasty ]
author: Reevh

notes: Age up with @landmark_zhuxi/meditation-gardens-1.webp@ on a resource cluster with 1 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@
Age up to castle with @landmark_zhuxi/shaolin-monastery-2.webp@ with 4 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@
Produce 1-3  @unit_zhuxi/shaolin-monk-3.webp@ & Make a @building_military/stable.webp@ for lancer and map control or @building_military/barracks.webp@ if under feudal pressure
Mass units, take all relics and sacred sites and play aggressively

description: Mass Zhuge Nu Rush by Beasty.
name: Mass Zhuge Nu Rush - Beasty
author: Etherz

notes: 5 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ Till Carring 5 to 7 @resource/resource_wood.png@ -> @building_economy/mill.png@ on @resource/berrybush.png@(Dont drop@resource/resource_wood.png@ on TC)
1@resource/resource_food.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-china.png@ makes @landmark_zhuxi/meditation-gardens-1.png@ next to as much @resource/berrybush.png@ as possible

1 @resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager-china.png@ makes 3 @building_military/archery-range.png@ After @landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.png@ is completed (if against horseman, make @building_military/barracks.png@ -> @unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@)

name: 1 TC Zhugenu All IN against Defensive Civs
author: schwarzfuß Sanji

notes: all @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ get 6, then take all build @building_economy/mill.png@ and shift to sheeps. Supervise with @unit_chinese/imperial-official.png@
rally 7 to @resource/sheep.webp@ then 1 to @resource/resource_gold.png@ then 1 to @resource/sheep.png@ and 2 more to @resource/resource_gold.png@

1 build @landmark_zhuxi/meditation-gardens-1.webp@ near berries. take 3 from @resource/sheep.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ build @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ supervise @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@
get @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ and supervise it then @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.png@, Supervise @resource/resource_wood.png@+@resource/resource_food.png@ collect taxes sometimes

new @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.png@ and @resource/resource_wood.png@. 1 vill builds @building_military/archery-range.png@@building_military/archery-range.png@@building_military/archery-range.png@ @unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.png@ Asap

new vills to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ Constantly produce @unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.png@@unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.png@@unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.png@ + @unit_siege/battering-ram.png@ or @building_defensive/outpost.png@

2 from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ build 2 more @building_military/archery-range.png@@building_military/archery-range.png@ back to @resource/resource_wood.png@, rally up to 20 on @resource/resource_wood.png@
Finish Him / Her / He she it
@resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.png@ until Age Up and supervise @building_economy/mill.png@

If opponent is agressive, get @resource/berrybush.webp@, @resource/sheep.png@ and transition to @building_chinese/granary.png@, otherwise get @resource/deer.png@, map control, then @building_chinese/granary.png@.
Start building production facilities to put pressure.

name: Zhu Xi Fast Castle into Lancers
author: cyberspacee

notes: 5@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ on wood don't drop to TC create a mill and supervise it.
1 from food builds @building_chinese/village.webp@ and back to food
Remember to pick up @resource/resource_gold.webp@ with @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ from @building_economy/mill.webp@

Build @landmark_zhuxi/meditation-gardens-1.webp@ near @resource/berrybush.webp@ and @resource/resource_gold.webp@if possible with 3 from @resource/resource_food.webp@and send 2 to @resource/resource_wood.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@

After age up move @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ from @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to  get @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@ and queue @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ when possible to get taxes
Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ or @building_military/barracks.webp@ (depending on units) if enemy is denying @resource/deer.webp@
Add more production buildings if needed and supervise with @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ for fast produce
Build @landmark_zhuxi/mount-lu-academy-1.webp@ with 7 from @resource/resource_food.webp@ and build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ with 1 from @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Return @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ back to @resource/resource_food.webp@ after age up and @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@
Queue up Regional Inspection from @landmark_zhuxi/mount-lu-academy-1.webp@ instantly with @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@
Supervise @building_military/stable.webp@ with @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@@unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@ to enemy base
Build @building_religious/monastery.webp@ and get @resource/relics.webp@ if game goes on and keep producing @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@

description: Wanted to play some Zhuge Nu aggression to help out my teammates in teamgames and had to make a new buildorder due to many changes since the old ones.
name: Zhuge Nu-Timing-Attack
author: Yufka1954

notes: build@building_economy/mill.webp@with all 5@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@and rally all@resource/sheep.webp@onto it, supervise building@building_economy/mill.webp@with@unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@

start building 3@building_military/archery-range.webp@and further@building_military/barracks.webp@when needed at@landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.webp@, set@landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.webp@to City Guard
collect taxes so you can afford @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@, rally until 8@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@on@resource/sheep.webp@and get@technology_economy/horticulture.webp@

get 1@unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@and rally@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@onto@resource/resource_gold.webp@until 6, at 7-10 @unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.webp@go out to harass enemy@resource/resource_gold.webp@and stop production for@technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@and@technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@

rally@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@onto@resource/resource_food.webp@now, build@building_chinese/village.webp@at 46 supply, start@unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.webp@and@technology_military/siege-engineering.webp@, built new@building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@forward for max income
